heading: top-center
name: 直式圖片網格（標題與次要文字左右並排、底部橫跨按鈕）
desc: 上方置中標題，下方多個等寬項目排成網格；每個項目是直式圖片、標題與靠右的次要文字，最下方一顆橫跨項目寬度的按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方置中放標題組；標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字與按鈕，沒有時省略。標題組下方是多個項目排成的網格，對齊頁面內容寬度，數欄，每列數量依內容而定；項目等寬，頂部對齊，沒有外框或底色。每個項目上方是一張直式圖片，所有圖片同一比例，佔項目大部分高度；圖片下方一列：左側是標題（可多行），右側靠右放一段次要文字，兩者頂部對齊，次要文字沒有時省略；項目最下方是一顆按鈕，按鈕橫跨整個項目的寬度，同一列各項目的按鈕對齊在同一高度，不受標題行數影響。
mobile: 結構不變，網格改為每列兩個項目；每個項目內的次要文字改放在標題下方，不再左右並排；按鈕仍橫跨整個項目的寬度，同一列的按鈕對齊在同一高度。

en.name: Portrait image grid (title and secondary text side by side, spanning button at the bottom)
en.desc: A centered title on top, with multiple equal-width items in a grid below; each item has a portrait image, a title with right-aligned secondary text, and a button spanning the item's width at the bottom.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, centered; the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description and button below; omit them when there is no content. Below the heading group, multiple items are arranged in a grid aligned to the page content width, in several columns, with the number per row depending on the content; the items are equal width, top-aligned, and have no frame or background. At the top of each item is a portrait image, all images in the same ratio, taking up most of the item's height; below the image is one row: a title on the left (may wrap to multiple lines) and a piece of secondary text aligned right, both aligned at the top; omit the secondary text when there is no content. At the very bottom of the item is a button spanning the full width of the item, and the buttons of all items in the same row are aligned at the same height regardless of how many lines the titles take.
en.mobile: The structure stays the same, with the grid changing to two items per row; within each item the secondary text moves below the title instead of sitting beside it; the button still spans the full width of the item, and the buttons in the same row are aligned at the same height.
